title: 瑞银胡一帆：5月经济数据好坏参半，二季度GDP不会太弱
speaker: You Song

segments.en: But one thing I want to say is the IP data was okay.
segments.zh: 但我想说一点，工业增加值数据还可以。

segments.en: It wasn't particularly strong, but not quite as weak as it was in April.
segments.zh: 不算特别强劲，但也不像4月那么弱。

segments.en: One other important data, which is not, I think the market should pay more attention to is service output index.
segments.zh: 另一个重要数据，我认为市场应更多关注的是服务业产出指数。

segments.en: And that number was okay as well. Slightly higher than it was in April.
segments.zh: 这个数据也还可以，比4月略高。

segments.en: And there's two IP and service output. There's two indices have a fairly close correlation with GDP data.
segments.zh: 工业增加值和产出指数这两个指标与GDP数据相关性相当高。

segments.en: So I think two Q GDP data, by the way, looks, it's going to be weak, but not quite as weak as one would expect from April data.
segments.zh: 所以我认为二季度GDP数据看起来会偏弱，但不会像4月数据预示的那么弱。
